privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: At Moxbnb, we respect your privacy. This policy explains what data we collect, why we use it, and your rights when you use our accommodation, experience, and service platform in Tunisia.
privacyPolicy.contactLabel: For questions or requests about your data, contact us at
privacyPolicy.section1Body: Moxbnb is responsible for personal data collected through the website, applications, and related services. This policy applies to guests, hosts, providers, and visitors.
privacyPolicy.section2Body: We may collect information you provide, including your name, email address, phone number, profile photo, account details, listings, bookings, messages, reviews, and payment information. We also collect technical data such as IP address, device type, browser, connection logs, and pages viewed.
privacyPolicy.section3Body: We use your data to create and secure your account, process bookings and payments, connect users, display and manage listings, provide support, prevent fraud, improve our services, send essential communications, and, with your consent, send offers and updates.
privacyPolicy.section4Body: We process data when necessary to perform a contract, comply with a legal obligation, protect our legitimate interests, or when you have provided consent. You may withdraw consent at any time for processing based on consent.
privacyPolicy.section5Body: We share only the data needed with users involved in a booking, our technical and payment providers, security partners, and authorities when required by law. We do not sell your personal data.
privacyPolicy.section6Body: We retain your data for as long as needed for the purposes described and then for applicable legal periods. We use reasonable technical and organizational safeguards, but no online service can guarantee absolute security.
privacyPolicy.section7Body: Subject to applicable law, you may request access, correction, deletion, restriction, or portability of your data, object to certain processing, and withdraw consent. Exercise these rights by writing to contact@moxbnb.tn. You may also contact the relevant data protection authority.
privacyPolicy.section8Body: We use cookies required for platform operation, security, and language preferences. Analytics or personalization cookies may be used with your consent. You can manage cookies in your browser, but some features may then be limited.
privacyPolicy.section9Body: Our services are not intended for people who do not have the legal capacity to enter into a contract. If you believe a child has provided us with data, contact us so we can delete it where appropriate.
privacyPolicy.section10Body: Some providers may process data from another country. Where required, we use appropriate safeguards in accordance with applicable legal requirements.
privacyPolicy.section11Body: We may update this policy to reflect changes to our services or the law. The update date appears at the top of this page. For any request, contact contact@moxbnb.tn.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of Moxbnb and bookings for accommodation, experiences, and services offered on the platform.
terms.section1Body: You must provide accurate information, keep your credentials private, and use Moxbnb lawfully. You are responsible for activity performed through your account.
terms.section2Body: Moxbnb connects guests, hosts, and providers. Hosts and providers are responsible for the accuracy of their listings, availability, and offers.
terms.section3Body: Prices, fees, cancellation rules, and payment terms are shown before confirmation. A confirmed booking is an agreement between the relevant parties, subject to the displayed rules.
terms.section4Body: Published content must be lawful, accurate, and respectful. Fraud, harassment, payment circumvention, misleading content, and unlawful use are prohibited.
terms.section5Body: Moxbnb provides a connection service and is not a party to agreements between users unless stated otherwise. We do not guarantee continuous availability or error-free third-party listings.
terms.section6Body: We may restrict or suspend an account for violations, fraud risk, or legal requirements. You may close your account by contacting us, subject to obligations from active bookings.
terms.section7Body: For questions about these terms, contact contact@moxbnb.tn.

cookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
cookiePolicy.intro: Cookies are small files stored on your device. Moxbnb uses them to operate the platform, remember preferences, and understand how it is used.
cookiePolicy.section1Body: They support sign-in, security, navigation, sessions, and language preferences. They are essential for the service to work.
cookiePolicy.section2Body: With your consent, we may measure visits and page usage to improve performance and user experience.
cookiePolicy.section3Body: You can accept, block, or delete cookies through your browser settings. Blocking necessary cookies may prevent some features from working.
cookiePolicy.section4Body: For questions about cookies, email contact@moxbnb.tn.

helpCenter.title: Help Center
helpCenter.intro: Find answers to common questions about your account, bookings, and listings.
helpCenter.section1Body: Use the sign-in page to access your account. If you have trouble with your password or email address, contact our team.
helpCenter.section2Body: Booking details, price, and cancellation terms are available before confirmation and in your personal area.
helpCenter.section3Body: Create a host or provider account from the dedicated sign-up pages, then manage listings, services, and requests from your dashboard.
helpCenter.section4Body: Our team is available at contact@moxbnb.tn for help with your account, a booking, or a report.
